outcome: Emotional well-being (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) score)
cohort: Pregnant Somali-born women residing in Sweden, recruited before 25 gestational weeks, with 64 in the gANC group and 81 in the sANC group.
finding: While no relevant differences were found in overall ratings of antenatal care, the intervention group experienced a greater reduction in mean EPDS score and reported greater satisfaction with received pregnancy and birth information.
mod_finding: Women in language-supported gANC were significantly happier with information received regarding caesarean section compared to standard care.
